retrievalProfile.description: A retro airbrushed illustration style featuring a pin-up figure and arched typography painted directly onto a riveted, metallic aircraft fuselage.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized airbrushed painting of a central pin-up figure flanked by large, vibrant script lettering, set against a weathered, riveted tan-colored metal aircraft skin with bomb silhouette tally marks.
coreVisualRelationships: Pin-up figure as the central vertical anchor
Arched typography framing the upper and lower subject
Tally marks (bombs) providing a rhythmic diagonal background element
Riveted metal panels defining the perspective of the aircraft
coreInvariants: Visible rivet lines and panel seams
Soft, airbrushed gradients for skin and metal
High-contrast black outlines on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical pin-up figure, occupying roughly 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pin-up figure's face and the vibrant orange script text above her.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top script, down the figure's body, following the curve of the lower text and the diagonal line of bomb silhouettes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The tan metallic fuselage acts as the negative space, textured with rivets and panel lines.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements (text and figure) against a desaturated, matte metallic background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual script and arched block serif
letterConstructionRules: Upper text: Thick, fluid script with heavy black outlines and internal orange-to-yellow gradients.
Lower text: Arched, slab-serif block letters with a weathered, stenciled appearance.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'T' has a long, sweeping horizontal bar.
Lower text follows a precise circular arc.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vibrant, organic script paired with rigid, arched military stenciling.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-painted, fluid look of 1940s nose art.
Captures the military utility aesthetic for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a WWII bomber fuselage with visible rivets, panel lines, and a central pin-up girl figure. Include a row of black bomb silhouettes in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom script lettering in orange with black outlines above the figure, and arched block serif text below the figure, following the curve of the fuselage.

verificationChecks: Are the rivets and panel lines visible?
Does the text have a thick black outline?
Is the pin-up figure central to the composition?
Is the color palette dominated by warm tan and orange?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figure
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Consistent perspective between art and aircraft

postGenerationChecks: Verify rivet alignment with panel seams
Ensure text follows the perspective of the fuselage
Confirm the pin-up style is retro-appropriate
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Pin-up Figure] with [Background: Riveted Metal Fuselage] and [Typography: Arched Script and Stencil] in a [Style: 1940s Airbrushed Nose Art] aesthetic.
